test_coverage_notes: STArray deserialization and validation logic is typically tested in protocol-level or serialization/deserialization unit tests. Look for test files such as 'test/protocol/STArray_test.cpp', 'test/protocol/STObject_test.cpp', or integration tests that exercise transaction or ledger serialization. Gaps may exist if tests do not cover malformed input (e.g., arrays with non-object fields, unknown fields, or illegal terminators). Exception paths (Throw) should be explicitly tested for coverage.
